basic_details.job_title: BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Project Scientist, Research Associate and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Seven purely temporary project posts are open at the Centre for DNA Fingerprinting and Diagnostics (BRIC-CDFD), Hyderabad, an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. The posts are Project Scientist – III, Project Scientist – II, Research Associate (RA) - I, Project Technical Support - III (two posts), Senior Project Scientist and Technical Coordinator, in three rare-disease research projects, initially for six months, with pay from Rs. 28,000/- + 24% HRA to Rs. 78,000/- + 24% HRA. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice gives the pay as monthly consolidated emoluments. HRA is added on top of the consolidated amount for five posts: 24% HRA for Project Scientist – III (Rs. 78,000/-), Project Scientist – II (Rs. 67,000/-), Research Associate (RA) - I (Rs. 47,000/-) and Project Technical Support - III (Rs. 28,000/-), and 27% HRA for Senior Project Scientist (Rs. 60,750/-). The Technical Coordinator is paid Rs. 60,000/- consolidated. The position is purely temporary and is initially for a period of six months. The position could be extended/terminated depending on the continuation of the project. If more vacancies with identical job requirements become available within one year after the selection, these can also be filled from among the candidates who are empanelled for the position.

content_sections.heading: BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work only for the Technical Coordinator post. Act as a focal point for Rare Diseases Clinic at the CoEs. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination, and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations, and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review, and approval processes for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinating with the spokes in matters of proposal for equipment & consumables procurement, demand for funds, submission of Utilization Certificates, etc. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and internal reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings, and awareness programs at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counseling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers. Any selected individual may from time to time be assigned to perform any other duties commensurate with their qualifications by the Director, BRIC-CDFD.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: one each for Project Scientist – III, Project Scientist – II, Research Associate (RA) - I, Senior Project Scientist and Technical Coordinator, and two for Project Technical Support - III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting online applications is 30.11.2026; applications received after the last date are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the BRIC-CDFD Project Scientist – III post?
faq.answer: A Doctoral Degree in Science or Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent, plus seven years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organisations and Scientific activities and services.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for Project Scientist – III and Technical Coordinator, 40 years for Project Scientist – II, Research Associate (RA) - I and Senior Project Scientist, and 35 years for Project Technical Support - III, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Handicapped/Ex-service person/Women applicants as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Monthly consolidated emoluments range from Rs. 28,000/- + 24% HRA (Project Technical Support - III) to Rs. 78,000/- + 24% HRA (Project Scientist – III); the Technical Coordinator gets Rs. 60,000/- consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 24% HRA is added for Project Scientist – III, Project Scientist – II, Research Associate (RA) - I and Project Technical Support - III, and 27% HRA for Senior Project Scientist; the Technical Coordinator pay is printed as Rs. 60,000/- consolidated without HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for BRIC-CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply in the prescribed application form online at https://cdfd.org.in/APPS/empc/index.php, uploading soft copies of certificates for date of birth, educational qualifications and reservation category (if applicable), along with a Statement of Purpose.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BRIC-CDFD project posts?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the online interview date and time.

faq.question: Q9. Are the BRIC-CDFD posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary and initially for six months, and could be extended/terminated depending on the continuation of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Can a Master's degree holder register for a Ph.D. after selection?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that selection against the position will not make candidates with a Master’s Degree eligible to register for the Ph.D. degree.
